# Start of Pakistan (SOP)

> SOP is an eCommerce and automation studio in Jhelum, Pakistan that runs Amazon seller accounts, builds Shopify and custom-coded online stores, and sets up AI and marketing automation for brands selling in the UK and US.

Work is scoped in writing with a fixed price before it starts. Accounts, code and data stay in the client's name. The team works a few hours ahead of the UK, so daily account work is usually done before the client's morning.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.startofpakistan.com/services): every service SOP offers, grouped by marketplace, web development, AI automation and digital.
- [Amazon Account Management](https://www.startofpakistan.com/amazon-account-management): full-service Amazon agency work for UK and US sellers — Seller Central and Vendor Central account management, listings and catalogue support.
- [Amazon PPC Management](https://www.startofpakistan.com/amazon-ppc-management): Amazon ads management covering Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, with weekly search-term and bid work.
- [Shopify Development](https://www.startofpakistan.com/shopify-development): Shopify store builds, migrations from WooCommerce and other platforms, custom theme work and Shopify SEO.
- [Ecommerce Website Development](https://www.startofpakistan.com/ecommerce-website-development): bespoke ecommerce sites coded by hand in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, plus redesigns and conversion rate optimisation.
- [AI Automation](https://www.startofpakistan.com/ai-automation): AI agents and business automation for customer replies, reporting, admin work and content, with human review built in.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.startofpakistan.com/marketing-automation): CRM setup, segmentation, email sequences and lead nurturing built around the tools a team already uses.

## Blog

- [What Is a Good ACoS on Amazon? (And How to Lower It)](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/what-is-a-good-acos): how ACoS is calculated, why a good figure depends on margin, and practical ways to bring it down.
- [TACoS vs ACoS: Which One Should Amazon Sellers Track?](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/tacos-vs-acos-amazon): the difference between the two metrics, what each one tells a seller, and which to use when.
- [How to Optimize an Amazon Listing: Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/how-to-optimize-amazon-listing): keywords, title, bullet points, description, backend search terms, images, A+ Content and reviews.
- [Amazon A+ Content Examples That Help Listings Sell](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/amazon-a-plus-content-examples): what A+ Content is, who is eligible, the common module types, example layouts and mistakes to avoid.
- [How Much Does Amazon Account Management Cost in the UK?](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/amazon-account-management-cost): common pricing models, what is usually included, what moves the price, and what to ask before signing.
- [Amazon PPC Agency vs Managing Ads Yourself](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/amazon-ppc-agency-vs-diy): what running ads yourself involves, when an agency makes sense, and how to judge the results.
- [How to Choose an Amazon Agency: 10 Questions to Ask](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/how-to-choose-an-amazon-agency): ten questions on reporting, contracts, account access, category experience and communication, plus red flags.
- [How Much Does a Shopify Store Cost to Build?](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/shopify-store-cost): plan fees against build costs, theme versus custom design, apps, product setup and ongoing costs.
- [How to Choose a Shopify Development Partner](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/how-to-choose-shopify-development-partner): what a development partner should do, questions to ask, time zones, contracts and store ownership.
- [Shopify SEO Checklist for UK & US Stores](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/shopify-seo-checklist): store structure, product titles, meta titles, alt text, duplicate content, speed, schema and internal links.
- [WooCommerce to Shopify Migration: Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/woocommerce-to-shopify-migration): planning, moving products, customers and orders, 301 redirects to keep rankings, testing and launch.
- [Custom Website vs Shopify Theme: Which Is Right for You?](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/custom-website-vs-shopify): what each option gives you on design control, speed, cost and maintenance, and when each fits.
- [Does Your Online Store Need a Redesign? 7 Signs](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/online-store-redesign-signs): seven signs a store has outgrown its site, and what a redesign involves.
- [How AI Agents Automate Social Media Content for Businesses](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/ai-social-media-automation): what AI agents are, how they plan, draft and schedule posts, and where people still review.
- [Best AI Agents for Customer Support in the UK (2026 Guide)](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog/best-ai-agents-for-customer-support): what AI support agents handle, where they fall short, and what to check before choosing one.
- [All guides](https://www.startofpakistan.com/blog): index of every article.
